cues.notes: Black. At 3.8 s a thin slit of light low in frame: the gap under a trailer, seen from underneath.

lines.text: I was under the second trailer when the ground lit up white from underneath.

cues.notes: The rumble peaks and cuts dead at the flash. The flash itself is silent.

lines.text: Then nothing, for a long time.
The highway was a line of stopped cars with the doors open.
At last light, the radio found a voice.
Northern Recovery Authority. Aircraft will not land for fewer than ten. Gather. Report your number on channel seven at last light. Do not travel after dark.

cues.notes: The loop restarts under the narration at half volume and is cut by a click as the line ends.
No narration, by design. The bangs sit in silence and the drone; nothing else moves.
Narration waits 0.6 s, not 0.4, so it clears the third bang by more than a second.

lines.text: The message said: don't travel after dark.

cues.notes: Hold, then cut to black on the last word.
